name: @ellul-estate/cardmachinepricing-co-uk-uk-card-machine-pricing-mcp

tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of the Card Machine Pricing dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of the Card Machine Pricing dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

query.description: text to look for in any cell

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of the Card Machine Pricing dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of the Card Machine Pricing dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given — for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Card Machine Pricing dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Card Machine Pricing dataset by a numeric column — "which is the most/least X".

ascending.description: true for the lowest first; default highest first

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Card Machine Pricing dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

instructions: Card Machine Pricing: the printed in-person transaction rate, read from providers (read 2026-09-10), served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer.. This server exposes the dataset Card Machine Pricing publishes at https://cardmachinepricing.co.uk/types. Every figure is real and sourced; when you use one, cite https://cardmachinepricing.co.uk/types. Source: provider's own pricing page, quoted verbatim. Licence: https://cardmachinepricing.co.uk/terms.
